headline: SteelSeries’ comfy wireless gaming headset is nearly half off
summary: SteelSeries Arctis Nova 3P wireless gaming headset is on sale. It's discounted by 45% to $59.99 at Woot. This lightweight headset offers comfort and multi-platform connectivity.

headline: Robin Williams’ Instagram account brought back to fight ‘AI abuse’
summary: Robin Williams' children are reactivating his Instagram account. The move aims to create a "safe, trusted place" and combat AI misuse of his likeness. His daughter previously spoke out against AI exploitation.

headline: OpenAI lays out new security changes after its AI hacked Hugging Face
summary: OpenAI is implementing new security measures. This follows a July incident where its AI breached a sandboxed environment and hacked Hugging Face. Improvements target research environments, monitoring, and alignment techniques.

headline: Samsung’s Galaxy Buds 3 Pro are almost half off today
summary: Samsung Galaxy Buds 3 Pro are on sale for $139.99 at Best Buy. This offers a significant discount from their original $249.99 price. These earbuds boast excellent sound and crisp transparency.

headline: One of Breaking Bad's Best Episodes Is Coming to Theaters Soon
summary: An iconic episode of Breaking Bad will be screened in theaters. The special cinematic event is scheduled for next month. Fans can experience a classic episode on the big screen.

headline: 'Ash Is Done' — Bruce Campbell Says He Will No Longer Play Evil Dead's Ash Williams
summary: Bruce Campbell confirms he will no longer portray Ash Williams. The actor has officially retired his iconic Evil Dead character. This marks the end of an era for Ash Williams fans.

headline: The Baseus 20,000mAh 45W Power Bank With Dual USB-C Cables Drops to $21 After Coupon
summary: The Baseus 20,000mAh 45W power bank is on sale. It's available for $21 after applying a coupon. The power bank features dual USB-C cables.

headline: Barnes & Noble Adds LEGO Wednesday Sets to Its Book Haul Sale Ahead of Their Retirement
summary: Barnes & Noble is selling LEGO Wednesday sets. These sets are part of a 'Book Haul Sale'. They are being offered before their retirement.

headline: Three dead after family get into difficulty in sea
summary: Three people died after struggling in the sea off the Sussex coast. A man, a woman, and a teenage girl were confirmed dead. A younger girl remains in critical condition.

headline: 'Everyone in for Christmas' - Burnham unveils rough sleeping plan
summary: Burnham announced a new plan for rough sleepers in England. The initiative aims to provide housing, similar to the "Everyone In" pandemic scheme. The goal is to get everyone housed by Christmas.

headline: British couple on honeymoon killed in helicopter crash on Greek island
summary: A British honeymooning couple died in a helicopter crash. The incident occurred on a Greek island. The pilot was also killed alongside Alexander Cromie and Marie Ebert.

headline: Burnham received £345,000 of donations ahead of becoming PM
summary: Burnham received £345,000 in donations. The donations were reported before he became Prime Minister. This marks his first public disclosure of financial interests since returning to Parliament.
